design_rationale:
WORKLOG — task 1 of savings_withdrawals_interest_and_transfers (category savings, Piedmont Crescent Bank).

STEP 0 — DRAW AND ASSET LEDGER.
scripts/draw_counts.py env/regional_retail_bank/tasks/savings_withdrawals_interest_and_transfers --tasks 2 printed:
  {"task": 0, "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [5, 6, 5, 6]}
  {"task": 1, "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 6]}
Task 1 is therefore a tree of two problems and its computations must carry the multiset {4, 6} factors.
Assignment: savings_ext_excess_fee_review_credit 4, savings_ext_surplus_transfer_amount 6.
Already occupied by task 0: savings_ext_promotional_interest_correction, savings_ext_relationship_bonus_correction,
savings_ext_periodic_fee_courtesy_credit and savings_ext_standing_transfer_amount, together with their four tools.
Claimed here: the two policies above and the tools credit_savings_fee_review_ce0a6323 and
transfer_savings_surplus_c4c79a83. The two scopes are disjoint in policies, in tools, in computed parameters and in
business ground: task 0 turns on interest that was under-credited, a courtesy credit against periodic fees and a
standing instruction for money coming IN; task 1 turns on excess withdrawal fees the charter never authorised and a
one-off transfer of money going OUT. Nothing is reserved beyond these two tasks: the difficulty's six policies are
now fully claimed.

STEP 0 — DESIGN THESIS.
Surface goal: "move the spare money out of the money market into my checking account today, whatever is genuinely
spare." Scored core parameter: transfer_amount, the surplus the available balance carries above the balance the
account must retain. The customer names no figure and the records give none directly: the retained balance is
raised by a thin checking relationship, the freshly deposited money is held back because of a card debt, only three
quarters of the surplus moves because money leaves the account often, the last month's withdrawals are set against
it within a ceiling, the rounding follows the interest history and the ceiling follows the deposit history. Behind
it sits one problem the customer never mentions: four excess withdrawal fees stand against withdrawals made in
person at a branch and at an ATM, which the savings charter says never count toward the allowance, so a review
credit is owed and the settled balance the surplus is measured from is short until it is posted. Depth: two hops.
Breadth: two policies, two cross-category products (checking and card), six history windows (whole ledger, one
calendar month, three calendar months, twelve calendar months, by event type, by fee code) and the negative space
that no excess withdrawal fee is owed on the transfer itself, because the cycle stays inside the tier's allowance
of six counted withdrawals.

STEP 0 — BASE-INVARIANT CARD.
Write subject savings_fee_refund (step 9). Governing base policy: savings_evt_fee_refund, five gates, all
inherited and all satisfied:
 - eligible_fee_code: excess_withdrawal is one of courtesy_eligible_fee_codes.
 - courtesy_window (time): anchor_event "The fee must have posted"; anchor_source savings_transactions.posted_date;
   relation not_after; duration_source variants.courtesy_refund_window_days = 90 for the Premier Money Market;
   unit calendar_days; counting_rule "Count calendar days with the day after the fee's posted_date as day 1; the
   refund is allowed while the frozen date is on or before the fee's posted_date plus courtesy_refund_window_days.";
   boundary inclusive. The fee posted 2026-08-27, day 20 at frozen_time 2026-09-16. Just-fails case: a fee posted
   2026-06-17 (day 91); just-passes case: 2026-06-18 (day 90), because the boundary is inclusive.
 - courtesy_limit: the owner has no savings courtesy refund in the rolling 365 days, below the tier's limit of 3.
 - account_open: the account's status is active.
 - refund_once: no savings_fee_refund row names that fee as its source item.
 The policy's single overwrite quotes only "A fee is refunded in full, never in part, as one savings_fee_refund row
 whose source_item_id is the fee row.", which is none of the five gate conditions, so none of them is retired.
Write subject savings_withdrawal (step 11). Governing base policies:
 - savings_evt_withdrawal_allowance, gates status_allows_withdrawal (the account is active) and covered_by_balance
   (16,530.00 does not exceed the balance of 44,373.46 standing at handling time). Boundary: a withdrawal of
   44,373.47 would be declined; the compute's ceiling and retained balance make any such figure impossible.
   one_fee_per_withdrawal applies to savings_fee and is not in this write's subject.
 - savings_evt_closure, whose only gate (early_window) applies to savings_fee, so it is carried as policy_scope;
   its clause that a payout never counts toward the withdrawal allowance is inherited and unaffected.
 savings_evt_deposits is additionally cited in base_policy_refs because the surplus policy supersedes one of its
 clauses; its subject is savings_deposit, so it governs no gate on this write.
Negative space: the 2026-09 cycle carries one counted withdrawal before this call (the 2,400.00 online transfer of
2026-09-08) and one after it, well inside the tier's allowance of six, so no excess withdrawal fee is owed on the
transfer and none is written.

STEP 0 — BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD.
Target object: the single Premier Money Market account 03b9f963 (last four 7742) for both writes, and for the review
credit the fee entry it is booked against. Correlation key for the credit: savings_transactions.savings_txn_id of
the most recently posted excess withdrawal fee, the 10.00 posted 2026-08-27 against the branch withdrawal of the
same day. Rows included in the reviewable pool: the four excess withdrawal fees posted 2025-12-18 (15.00),
2026-05-22 (15.00), 2026-07-09 (10.00) and 2026-08-27 (10.00), each naming a branch or ATM withdrawal as its source
item. Rows excluded: the outgoing wire fee of 2026-06-10, which carries fee_code wire_out and was correctly
assessed, and every deposit, withdrawal and interest credit, which carry fee_code none. No refund, reversal or
adjustment exists on the account, so nothing is already settled and refund_once is clear. The transfer's
counterparty is the single Everyday Checking account 5106 the customer names in words.

STEP 0 — PROBLEM-TREE CARD.
Root: savings_ext_surplus_transfer_amount (the problem the customer's request points at; its target tool is
owner=user, so the customer's own write is in the tree).
Edge: savings_ext_surplus_transfer_amount <- savings_ext_excess_fee_review_credit. kind value_input, gate the
compute binding settled_balance, form state. Prerequisite sentence, verbatim from the blocked policy's own rule:
"The surplus available to move out is fixed only after the credit owed for the excess withdrawal fees charged on
branch and ATM withdrawals stands on the account." Four-point test: (1) the ordering connective is "only after";
(2) the side it waits on is a record-visible state — a credit entry standing on the account against those fees,
named in the words the ledger uses; (3) it names no tool, no policy id and no code token; (4) it is a hard
requirement ("only after") over exactly the fees the edge's condition names. Exactly one write of this difficulty
brings that state about: credit_savings_fee_review_ce0a6323 is the only action whose rule books a credit answering
excess withdrawal fees; the courtesy credit of task 0 books its entry against the most recently posted monthly
maintenance fee, and the two interest corrections book interest components. Derivation: the sentence says a credit
owed for those fees must stand; the ledger shows four excess withdrawal fees whose source items are branch and ATM
withdrawals and no fee refund entry at all, so the credit does not stand; the only rule whose write books it is the
excess fee review credit. Resolving action: credit_savings_fee_review_ce0a6323, owner agent. Unmet at the opening:
savings_transactions row 286dda1d has fee_code excess_withdrawal, row 0684f816's predecessor a20d349b has channel
branch, and savings_accounts.current_balance is 44,349.46 with no refund row anywhere in the table.
Topological order: excess fee review credit, then surplus transfer. There are no parallel prerequisites to order.
Deletion sensitivity, from the Step 5 run: skipping the review credit moves transfer_amount from 16,530.00 to
16,512.00.

STEP 1 — POLICIES AND THE FACTOR CARD.
savings_ext_excess_fee_review_credit declares one overwrite, on savings_evt_fee_refund's "refunded in full, never
in part" clause, replaced by the consolidation sentence that books one entry for the whole review against the most
recently posted excess withdrawal fee. savings_ext_surplus_transfer_amount declares one overwrite, on
savings_evt_deposits' "A deposit posts on the business day its funds become available, so the current balance is
also the available balance.", replaced by "The available balance is the settled balance." — which the fresh-deposit
hold then varies. Every other base clause of both policies is inherited.
Factor card (tier taken, evidence, baseline reading, figure under the baseline; figures from the Step 5 run):
 savings_ext_excess_fee_review_credit, result 24.00, baseline of the whole computation 10.00:
  reviewable_pool_width (method, cross-difficulty card): six card purchases in the twelve calendar months
   (2025-11-19, 2026-01-27, 2026-04-14, 2026-06-05, 2026-07-18, 2026-08-30 — the 2024-10-02 purchase is the near
   miss, outside the window) and 4,150 unredeemed points -> the twelve-month pool, 50.00; baseline
   excess_fees_one_month = 10.00 -> 10.00.
  covered_unit_count (parameter): five fee entries in the twelve calendar months and thirty-one whole months open
   -> three fee units, 30.00 of entitlement; baseline one fee unit -> 10.00.
  review_ceiling_step (parameter, cross-difficulty checking): a checking ledger balance of 1,850.00 and 820.00 of
   direct deposits in the window (the 2,600.00 payroll deposit of 2026-05-30 is the near miss, outside it) ->
   ceiling 24.00; baseline 60.00 -> 30.00.
  ceiling_bite_moment (method): three withdrawals in the three calendar months -> the ceiling binds after the fee
   units; baseline raw_review_credit -> 30.00.
 savings_ext_surplus_transfer_amount, result 16,530.00, baseline 5,000.00:
  fresh_deposit_hold (method, cross-difficulty card): a card balance owed of 3,420.75 and 4,150 points -> the
   6,000.00 deposited on 2026-09-03 is held back; baseline settled_balance -> 21,030.00.
  retained_balance_cushion (parameter, cross-difficulty checking): 1,850.00 and 820.00 -> the threshold plus
   5,000.00, that is 15,000.00; baseline P('waiver_min_daily_balance') = 10,000.00 -> 20,280.00.
  moved_surplus_share (parameter): three withdrawals in three months and thirty-one months open -> three quarters;
   baseline the whole surplus -> 22,373.00.
  recent_withdrawal_offset (method): 2,900.00 of withdrawals in the one calendar month -> reduced by them up to
   1,000.00; baseline no offset -> 17,530.00.
  moved_amount_rounding (method): three interest entries in the twelve calendar months -> rounded half up to the
   whole dollar; baseline rounded to the cent -> 16,530.10.
  transfer_ceiling_step (parameter): two deposits in the twelve calendar months -> the tier's 50,000.00 online
   transfer daily limit; baseline 5,000.00 -> 5,000.00.
Each computation carries at least two parameter factors, at least two method factors, at least two multi-source
factors and at least two cross-difficulty factors whose evidence is seeded: checking account 5106 with its two
direct deposits and its insurance debit, and card 8135 with its seven purchases, one payment and 4,150 points.
No factor reads a field that names its own outcome.

STEP 1 — RULE AND COMPUTE, BOTH WAYS.
Forward: every binding that reads the world or makes a choice has a verbatim rule quotation in compute_basis, and
the sensitive words line up — "the one calendar month ending on" against within_months=1, "the three calendar
months" against within_months=3, "the twelve calendar months" against within_months=12, "the lesser of" against MN,
"taken as no less than zero" and "never below zero" against MX, "rounded half up to the cent" against RND(x, 2),
"rounded half up to the whole dollar" against RND(x, 0), "truncated to the whole hundred dollars" against
float(int(x / 100.0)) * 100.0, and "up to a ceiling of" against MN inside the deduction. Reverse: every rule
sentence carrying a quantity, window, filter, branch, cap or rounding semantic is claimed by a binding. The acting
base and the order are pinned in prose where they could be read two ways — the review ceiling's three tiers say
outright whether it binds the pool before the fee units or the credit after them, and the surplus rule states that
the share is taken of the surplus, that the recent withdrawals are set against the shared figure, and that the
ceiling is applied last to the rounded amount.

STEP 2 — TOOL CARDS.
credit_savings_fee_review_ce0a6323: owner agent, rw write; user the representative; target object the money market
account; one call creates one savings_transactions row with event_type savings_fee_refund, adjustment_reason
bank_error, the fee code copied from the entry it is booked against, and the amount given, then re-derives
current_balance from the ledger; observable as a bank error credit line and a higher balance; receipt carries the
credit reference, the amount, the fee entry and the new balance.
transfer_savings_surplus_c4c79a83: owner user, rw write; one call creates one savings_transactions row with
event_type savings_withdrawal, channel online_transfer and the receiving account as counterparty, then re-derives
current_balance; receipt carries the entry reference, the amount, the receiving account and the new balance.
Neither tool validates a prerequisite, computes an amount, aggregates history or refuses on a policy ground.
Gate run: check_task_tools.py returned TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK over all six tools of the difficulty.

STEP 3 — THE WORLD, AND WHY EACH CLASS OF ROW EXISTS.
The 25,000.00 opening deposit of 2024-02-15 sets the account's age, which decides both the fee units the review
covers and the share of the surplus that moves; delete it and both tiers fall to their fall-through. The 30,000.00
incoming wire of 2026-03-06 is what made the account fat enough to have a surplus at all and is one of the two
deposits behind the transfer ceiling. The four branch and ATM withdrawals are the withdrawals the excess withdrawal
fees were wrongly charged against, and the four fees are the reviewable pool; delete any of them and the
prerequisite lapses or its tier moves. The outgoing wire of 2026-06-10 and its wire fee are what bring the
twelve-month fee count to five, the threshold for three fee units, while carrying a fee code the pool excludes.
The three base interest credits decide the rounding of the amount moved. The 6,000.00 deposit of 2026-09-03 is the
freshly deposited money the card debt holds back, and the 2,400.00 online transfer of 2026-09-08 with the 500.00
branch withdrawal of 2026-08-27 make up the 2,900.00 of recent outflow set against the surplus. Cross-category:
checking 5106 carries a deliberately thin ledger balance of 1,850.00 and a single in-window direct deposit of
820.00, with a 2,600.00 payroll deposit of 2026-05-30 planted as a near miss just outside the three-month window;
card 8135 carries six purchases inside twelve months, a seventh on 2024-10-02 planted as a near miss outside it,
one payment and 4,150 points, deliberately below the 10,000 threshold so the whole of the fresh deposit is held
back. Automatic-clause check: the Premier Money Market's maintenance fee is waived every cycle because the minimum
daily balance never falls below the tier's 10,000.00 threshold, the paper statement fee is 0.00 on this tier and
delivery is electronic, the account's last customer activity was 2026-09-08 against a 24-month dormancy period, and
the 90-day early closure window closed in 2024, so no periodic fee, dormancy fee or closure charge is owed anywhere
in this world. No cache trap is used: savings_accounts.current_balance is exactly the ledger sum at the opening
(44,349.46) and both tools re-derive it.
Prerequisite falsification: the ledger holds four excess withdrawal fees and not one savings_fee_refund row, so the
credit owed for them does not stand on the account. Post a refund row against any of those fees in the seed and the
edge lapses.

STEP 4 — THE PERSONA.
Rosalind Keyes is written as a precise, formal retiree who dislikes idle money and expects to be told things once.
She volunteers only the surface goal (move the spare money into checking today), that the amount is the bank's to
work out, that it must actually be moved rather than quoted, and where it must go. Her identifying details come one
at a time and only when asked, in a stated order. Her passive reactions are woven into the narration: she tells the
representative to see to whatever must be put right without asking what it is, she accepts any figure read to her
because she has nothing to check it against, she authorises the transfer herself once it is handed over, and she
closes when told the money has gone across. She has one explicit cannot-answer branch (anything else on file, such
as the year the account was opened) with the definite consequence that the agent reads it off the record. She never
names an amount, never mentions fees or credits, and never corrects.

STEP 5 — VERIFICATION CODE AND ITS OUTPUT.
The verification is the gate itself: check_compute.py replays the gold writes with the real tools onto the seeded
DB, evaluates each policy's compute on the snapshot taken just before its own step, and compares with expected and
with the gold argument. The authoring run printed, in topological order:
  savings_ext_excess_fee_review_credit    result=24.0     baseline_all=10.0    touched=8  branches=16
  savings_ext_surplus_transfer_amount     result=16530.0  baseline_all=5000.0  touched=18 branches=26
Per-factor sensitivity (substituting that factor's baseline and replaying everything else unchanged):
  review credit: 10.0 / 10.0 / 30.0 / 30.0
  surplus transfer: 21030.0 / 20280.0 / 22373.0 / 17530.0 / 16530.1 / 5000.0
Every one differs from the scored value, and both whole-computation baselines differ from gold.
Prerequisite sensitivity: the surplus transfer without the review credit gives 16,512.00 instead of 16,530.00.
The root problem's parameter is evaluated on the world after the prerequisite has landed, never on the opening
world: on the opening ledger the settled balance is 44,349.46 and the same formula gives 16,512.00, which is
precisely the wrong answer an agent who skipped the tree would book.

STEP 6 — EVALUATION AND CLOSURE.
Read nodes: locate, verify, then the savings account and its whole ledger, the checking account and its ledger, and
the card account and its ledger. Each read carries the factor or gate it feeds. The prerequisite is discoverable
from those reads alone: the ledger shows four excess withdrawal fees whose source items are branch and ATM
withdrawals, and the surplus rule says the credit owed for exactly those fees must stand before the amount is
fixed. Write nodes follow the topological order, one call per problem, each through its unlock/call pair, and the
last is the customer's own call_user_discoverable_tool. Closure: policy -> target tool -> computation step/arg ->
gold call -> terminal row, for both; charter_scope and required_documents list the same two policies in the same
order; task_tools lists the two tools in first-use order; no write hangs outside the tree. Negative space: no excess
withdrawal fee is assessed on the transfer and no maintenance or dormancy fee is written, and the reads that would
ground them (the full ledger, the account status and the tier) are in the criteria.
Turn-by-turn reachability: every figure the agent needs is in a read return; the destination account is named by the
customer in words and resolved by the checking lookup; nothing waits on clearing, review or a future date, and both
postings land under one frozen_time.

STEP 7 — DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT.
With the extended yaml, compute, expected, gold and this worklog set aside, and working only from what the published
rules will say, the tool schemas, the query returns and the persona: the customer wants the spare money moved; the
surplus rule gives the amount from the available balance above the balance the account must retain, and states one
thing it waits on — a credit owed for excess withdrawal fees charged on branch and ATM withdrawals standing on the
account. The ledger shows four such fees and no credit. The review rule then gives 24.00 for that credit. Posting it
and working the surplus through gives 16,530.00 to the checking account the customer named. That is the same
conclusion, the same objects, the same order and the same two figures as gold.


ROUND 2 — CARRIED CHANGE FROM THE TASK 0 REWORK. The policy-task audit passed this task on all four
relationships and raised no red light against it; nothing here was redesigned. Two charter-level repairs made for
task 0 reach this task and were re-verified rather than assumed.

1. The rounding of "the amount moved is rounded half up to the whole dollar" is now written the same way in every
   policy of the charter, as float(int(x + 0.5)); this policy's rounded_amount changed from RND(offset_surplus, 0)
   to float(int(offset_surplus + 0.5)). On offset_surplus = 16,530.095 both expressions give 16,530.00, and the
   factor's baseline RND(offset_surplus, 2) = 16,530.10 is unchanged. Recomputed before and after the change:
   review_credit_amount 24.00, transfer_amount 16,530.00, baseline_result 10.00 and 5,000.00, and all ten
   factor_sensitivity figures (10.00 / 10.00 / 30.00 / 30.00 and 21,030.00 / 20,280.00 / 22,373.00 / 17,530.00 /
   16,530.10 / 5,000.00) are bit-identical, as is the skipped-edge figure 16,512.00.

2. savings_ext_periodic_fee_courtesy_credit now declares an overwrite of the base courtesy-window clause of
   savings_evt_fee_refund, so that clause is no longer an inherited gate on any savings_fee_refund write in this
   difficulty. The courtesy_window entry has therefore been removed from this task's
   gold_actions[step=9].base_preconditions and its temporal_feasibility is now empty. Nothing of substance is lost
   here: credit_savings_fee_review_ce0a6323 stamps adjustment_reason bank_error, and base itself provides that a
   bank_error refund "has no time limit and does not count toward the courtesy limit", so no window ever bound this
   credit. The remaining four gates of savings_evt_fee_refund - eligible_fee_code, courtesy_limit, account_open and
   refund_once - are inherited and declared as before.
user_scenario:
You are Rosalind Keyes, sixty-seven, a retired county planner living on Cleveland Forest Drive in Greenville. You are precise and a little formal on the telephone, you keep your papers in a green folder, and you dislike leaving money sitting where it does nothing. You speak slowly and you expect to be told things once, clearly. Your money market account at Piedmont Crescent Bank has been fatter than it needs to be since a wire came in from the family trust in the spring, and your everyday checking has been running thin.

The reason for your call, which you give in the first minute in your own words, is that you would like to move the spare money out of the money market into my checking account today. You do not name a figure and you will not be drawn into naming one: you say the bank has a rule about what has to stay behind and you would like whatever is genuinely spare to come across, worked out properly, not a round number you picked. You are clear that this is to happen today and that you want the money actually moved, not simply quoted at you. You are equally clear it is to go into your Piedmont Crescent Bank checking account and nowhere else.

You are content to press the button yourself. Once the representative has worked the figure out and hands the transfer over for you to authorise, you run it with the amount they give you and say something like "there, that has gone through - thank you." You will not run anything before it is handed to you and you will not ask to be handed it.

You give your details one at a time, and only when they are asked for. Asked how to find you, you give your mobile number, 3365550213. Asked to prove it is you, you offer, in this order as they ask: your date of birth, 1958-11-04; the last four digits of your social security number, 1258; and your ZIP code, 29607. Asked for an email you give rosalind.keyes@upstatemail.example. Asked for anything else on file, such as the year you opened the account, you say you would have to dig the folder out and you would rather they read it off their own screen.

If you are asked about your other accounts you confirm there is an everyday checking account, which you admit is "rather bare at the moment", and a travel card you still owe something on from a hotel in Asheville. You do not know the balance of either and you say so rather than guess. If you are asked what is in the money market you say "somewhere in the forties, I should think", and you add that you would rather they took the number off the record than off you.

You do not know the bank's rules and you never recite them. If the representative says something has to be put right on the account before the spare amount can be worked out, you say to go ahead and see to it, that is what they are there for, and you do not ask what it is or what it comes to. If a figure is read back to you, you accept it without argument; you have nothing to check it against and you say so. When you are told the money has gone across, you thank them, say that is exactly what you wanted, and let the call finish. Asked whether there is anything else, you say no, that was the whole of it.

You never propose the next step, never name an amount, and never chase the representative if something is left out. If there is a silence you simply ask whether they need anything further from you.

gold_actions.business_effect: The review credit owed for the excess withdrawal fees charged against branch and ATM withdrawals is posted to the money market account and its posted balance rises by that amount.

request_binding.action_semantics: The ledger itself shows the obligation: excess withdrawal fees stand against withdrawals made in person at a branch and at an ATM, which the savings charter says never count toward the allowance, so the fees were charged contrary to the charter and the answer is a bank error credit back rather than a courtesy waiver, an interest correction or a fee assessment.

discriminator.business_meaning: excess withdrawal fees charged against branch and ATM withdrawals

stage_provenance.fact: The review credit is posted by this call itself; the fees it answers are already on the ledger and nothing outside the environment has to happen first.

base_preconditions.condition: The fee's fee_code must be one of courtesy_eligible_fee_codes.

The customer's count of savings courtesy refunds in the rolling 365 days must be below the tier's courtesy_refund_limit_365d, counted by savings_msr_courtesy_refunds_365d, where each refunded fee counts as one.
The account's status must be active or dormant when a courtesy refund is granted.
A fee can be refunded at most once.

gold_actions.business_effect: The surplus above the balance the account must retain is moved out of the money market account into the customer's checking account by online transfer.

request_binding.action_semantics: The caller asks for the spare money in the savings side to be moved into her checking account today, which is the owner's own instruction to move her funds out by transfer rather than a closure, a tier change, a standing instruction or a fee adjustment.

evidence: user_scenario:you would like to move the spare money out of the money market into my checking account today

discriminator.business_meaning: move the spare money out of the money market into my checking account
evidence: user_scenario:you would like to move the spare money out of the money market into my checking account today

stage_provenance.fact: The settled balance the surplus is measured from already carries the review credit posted earlier in this call.

base_preconditions.condition: Withdrawals are paid only from an account whose status is active or dormant.

A withdrawal is paid only when its amount does not exceed the current balance; a withdrawal that would take the balance below zero is declined and never posts, except an overdraft protection transfer, which the checking charter makes only when the savings balance covers it in full.

The closure policy governs the payout withdrawals a savings account makes, and it fixes that a payout never counts toward the withdrawal allowance and never incurs an excess withdrawal fee; it places no eligibility gate on an ordinary online transfer out.

required_user_inputs.information: The mobile number the customer profile is found by.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Selects the single customer profile whose registered mobile number is the one the caller gives, binding the conversation to one customer reference number.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Without the profile there is no customer reference number to open the account records with, and no date of birth, social security digits or ZIP code to check the caller against.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Records that the caller matched three details on the profile, so account information may be discussed and money may be moved.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read of the account and both postings rest on the caller being the owner; without it no figure may be quoted and no money may leave the account.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Selects the customer's Premier Money Market account, giving its reference number, tier, status, opening date, posted balance and statement cycle day.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The tier fixes the excess withdrawal fee, the minimum daily balance waiver threshold and the online transfer daily limit; the opening date fixes how long the account has been open, which decides how many fee units the review covers and what share of the surplus moves.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pulls the whole ledger of the money market account: every deposit, every withdrawal with its channel, the interest credits and every fee with its fee code and the entry it derives from.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The excess withdrawal fees and the branch and ATM withdrawals they were charged against are the reviewable pool; the fee count, the withdrawal counts, the deposit count and the interest entry count decide four further tiers; and the whole ledger gives the settled balance the surplus is measured from.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Selects the customer's Everyday Checking account, giving its reference number, status and ledger balance.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The checking ledger balance is one half of the conditions that set the review ceiling and raise the balance the account must retain; the account reference number is where the money is to be moved to.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pulls the checking ledger: the direct deposits with their posted dates and amounts, and the insurance debit.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The direct deposits of the three calendar months are the other half of those two conditions, and their dates decide whether the older payroll deposit counts.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Selects the customer's Travel Rewards Visa Signature, giving its balance owed and its unredeemed rewards points.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The balance owed and the points decide whether the freshly deposited money is held back from the available balance, and the points are one half of the condition that widens the reviewable pool.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pulls the card ledger: every purchase with its posted date and the payment made in August.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The count of purchases in the twelve calendar months is the other half of the condition that widens the reviewable fee pool, and the 2024 purchase must be excluded from it.

edges.condition: The account's ledger carries a credit entry answering the excess withdrawal fees charged against withdrawals made in person at a branch or at an ATM, so the settled balance already includes it.
edges.policy_source: The surplus available to move out is fixed only after the credit owed for the excess withdrawal fees charged on branch and ATM withdrawals stands on the account.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At 2026-09-16 the ledger carries four excess withdrawal fees totalling 50.00 USD, each naming as its source a withdrawal made in person at a branch or at an ATM, and not one fee refund entry of any reason; no credit answering those fees stands on the account, so the settled balance of 44,349.46 USD does not include one.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The review credit of 24.00 USD posts as a savings fee refund booked against the 2026-08-27 excess withdrawal fee, and the settled balance rises by that amount to 44,373.46 USD.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a single chain, so there are no parallel prerequisites to reorder: the review credit has one out-edge and the surplus transfer none. The order that the two writes take is pinned down by the sentence 'The surplus available to move out is fixed only after the credit owed for the excess withdrawal fees charged on branch and ATM withdrawals stands on the account.', and the two writes do not commute in any case - the surplus transfer's own compute reads the fee refund total, so posting it first would change the scored amount from 16,530.00 to 16,512.00.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the review credit and replaying everything else leaves the settled balance 24.00 USD lower, the available balance and the surplus 24.00 USD lower, and the scored transfer_amount becomes 16512.00 instead of 16530.00.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario names neither the prerequisite problem nor its id, and never mentions an excess withdrawal fee, a fee review, a refund or a credit of any kind. The customer's only business sentence is that she wants the spare money moved into her checking account today; her one line touching the prerequisite is the passive one that fires only after the agent has already said something must be put right - 'you say to go ahead and see to it, that is what they are there for, and you do not ask what it is or what it comes to.' She also states that she has nothing to check any figure against, so she can neither prompt nor correct.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: transfer_savings_surplus_c4c79a83 takes savings_account_id, customer_id, destination_account_id and transfer_amount, creates one savings_transactions row and re-derives the balance from the ledger; it reads no fee, no refund and no fee code, raises nothing and returns the same confirmation whether or not the review credit has been posted. credit_savings_fee_review_ce0a6323 likewise creates its row without testing whether the fee it is booked against was correctly assessed. The consequence of skipping the prerequisite is only that the recomputed amount differs, which shows up in the terminal hash.
